text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Four hundred ninety-nine,
five hun... dred!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~! I give up~!
...Aww, couldn't do it again~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No, if you can do that many in a row,
that's already plenty amazing...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "No, no~ I'm sure anyone could do this much~."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew, I've gotta keep training harder...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Past the middle of October, the days of relentless training for the "Japan Cup" continued.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, one day.
Matikanetannhauser received a letter from the round-glasses reporter who had interviewed her before.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The one with round glasses...? Ah, I remember! We talked during the "Diamond Stakes", right!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I'm so happy!
I wonder what it is?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed to be personal rather than related to the interview, so I handed it over without opening it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser opened the letter with a relaxed demeanor,
but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pa!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-Wah wah wah, wow...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...W-W-Wait, hold on!
I'm going out for a quick stroll!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worried by how suspiciously she left without even waiting for an answer,
I decided to secretly follow her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She was on a nearby hill. For some reason, she's keeping her distance from the letter."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!?
Huh, why?!
choice_data_list: I got worried. What on earth happened?
I got worried. What on earth happened?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Um, the thing is, well~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After stammering for a moment,
Matikanetannhauser quietly murmured.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: My journey of self-discovery has come to an end...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Without fully understanding what was happening, I looked at the letter handed to me—it was a long letter of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"—Actually, I was transferred to another department after that,
so right now I'm working in a field completely
unrelated to umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: "『At first, it was painful to leave the department I had built up in my own way and found so much fulfillment in, but...』"

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: "Seeing you give your all in the race gave me a push once again and helped me look forward."

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"You have given me courage time and time again,
so I took the liberty of writing this letter to thank you once more."

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"It might be rude of me
to say something like this, but..."

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because you were not 'special,'
seeing you strive forward resonated so deeply with everyone."

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"If only I were a completely different existence... brimming with talent,
radiant, and undeniably strong."

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure your words never reached them."

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: "‘Machikane Tannhauser is often called a "supporting character" due to her ordinariness, but――’"

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: "To me, it's precisely because you are 'ordinary' that you are the one and only 'protagonist.'"

text_block_list.name: Round-Glasses Reporter
text_block_list.text: "I will continue to cheer you on, even if it is from a bit of a distance."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...I used to think being the 'protagonist'
was something truly special."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I always saw her as someone sparkly and strong,
with a powerful presence that makes everyone want to follow in her footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's why I never understood what the chairwoman
meant when she told me, "Because it's you."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Still, now at last... it makes sense to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Being the 'protagonist'...
isn't just reserved for special people...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I was ordinary and plain,
there were people I was able to encourage...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The emphasis she placed on the word "protagonist"
suddenly brings back the memory of Machikane Tannhauser
wearing a truly radiant expression back then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Rice-san is Bourbon-san's hero...? Or rather, what would you call it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A presence shining brightly at the center of my heart,
giving me courage and the strength to move forward—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Protagonist."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember how that Matikane Tannhauser, who is always
so level-headed both before and after a race,
was unusually thrilled.
choice_data_list: ...Do you want to be more of a 'protagonist'?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In fact, over the past two years, many Umamusume have found the courage to look forward thanks to Matikane Tannhauser's words.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: E-Even more!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: If it were me—
choice_data_list: That letter is the best proof of all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser carefully smoothed out
the slightly crumpled edge of the letter.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "...Um, the truth is..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I've truly spent my whole life living 'normally,' you see.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Unlike Rice or Bourbon,
I've never really had strong feelings about
wanna be like this, or wanna be like that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If I had to say, I just wanted to win races
and see everyone smiling after the victory.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Still—um...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser stared into the air,
as if searching for the right words.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: A "protagonist"... might not be quite right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's been stuck in my heart ever since.
Bourbon-san's face that day, when she perked back up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And so, looking back on it now, I wonder if that feeling was 'envy.'

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I envy her. I want to become someone who can empower others like that, too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I could become one too.
For some reason, I just found myself thinking that...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It pierced deep inside me, and it's been
stuck there ever since. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A long silence falls—and then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll do it!
I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: First, in the upcoming Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I want the kind of power Rice-san had when she encouraged Bourbon-san that day—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The power of a 'protagonist' that moves people's hearts!
I want to give that to someone again!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I want to become the 'protagonist'...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ow?!
Ugh, ...got something in my eye...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ending was a bit anticlimactic...
but from that day on, something within her
had slightly, yet unmistakably, changed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, the Umamusume running in the Japan Cup gathered for a press conference.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Machikane Tannhauser-san,
could you share your enthusiasm
for the Japan Cup with us?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I was always just a supporting character.
I was fine with that, and I thought winning
was all that mattered. But...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Circumstances have changed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: In the next Japan Cup, I'll show everyone that I'm the main character!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And I want to give courage
to ordinary girls just like me.
I'll deliver the greatest race to do just that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser's words gradually began
to spread through the public—

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll go watch the Japan Cup. I heard Machitan's super fired up for it.

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I really like Machitan too.
She feels like someone you'd run into anywhere,
yet she's super positive and always tries her hardestâ

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text: It makes me feel like even an ordinary girl like me could become like Machitan if I give it my all and do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Expectations for the Japan Cup
slowly but surely began to mount.
